scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because checker cannot re-run DFT+Wannier pipeline; T2 consistency infeasible because exact reference curves from paper Figure 3 cannot be embedded as a fixed gold table; the paper's conclusions rest on qualitative thickness-dependent trends that can be verified directly from the agent's computed tensor curves, providing a robust verification of the main claim.

outputs.description: CSV containing the shift‑current tensor components. The hidden checker evaluates only structural trend compliance (shape gate and four thickness‑dependent trend checks) with specified weights; no point‑wise comparison against reference data is performed.

output_contract.notes: Only the shift‑current tensor is scored; the integrated figure‑of‑merit and Glass coefficient are excluded as supporting analyses. All raw DFT and Wannier‑interpolation logs are required process evidence.
